image_description: A low-angle, eye-level shot of an ornate church altar in a Gothic-style cathedral. The foreground features a semi-circular or curved altar table covered in a gold-patterned cloth with a white lace overlay. On the table are floral arrangements (pink and red roses), candles, and a central diamond-shaped reliquary or monstrance. Behind this is a raised stone reredos or secondary altar structure made of reddish-brown marble. The background shows the high vaulted ceilings, pointed arches, and stained glass windows of the sanctuary.
